categories.main_business_segments: Yangzhou Chenhua New Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the fine chemical new materials sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of fine chemical products. Its main product lines include surfactants, flame retardants, and silicone rubber. These products serve as additives to improve processing performance, product quality, or impart special application properties across various industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced industrial production technologies with proprietary patents in surfactants, flame retardants, and silicone rubber. It utilizes mature production processes supported by a strong R&D team and holds multiple patents. Key technologies include synthesis of alkyl glycosides, polyether amines, and flame retardant phosphates, with ongoing development in continuous silicone oil preparation and environmentally friendly production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chenhua serves a broad range of downstream industries including polyurethane, plastics, textiles, dyeing, daily chemicals, pesticides, railways, fire protection, wind power, petroleum shale gas extraction, gasoline cleaning, electronics, automotive, cables, and construction. Its customers include well-known domestic and international enterprises, with export markets covering Europe, America, Oceania, East Asia, Southeast Asia, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Yangzhou, Huai'an, Nanjing, Shanghai, Fuzhou, and Shandong. It has expanded its international presence through a wholly-owned subsidiary in Shanghai for global trade. Exports accounted for 13% of revenue in 2024, with products certified for sale in the European Union and other overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yangzhou Chenhua operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of fine chemical additives and new materials. It procures raw materials such as epoxides, fatty alcohols, and siloxanes from upstream suppliers and supplies additives to downstream manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology innovation and R&D investment, focusing on expanding production capacity for surfactants, polyurethane functional additives, and bio-based degradable materials. Key R&D projects include development of environmentally friendly flame retardants, continuous silicone oil production, alkyl glycoside decolorization, and new applications for polyether amines. It also emphasizes green manufacturing, energy efficiency, and compliance with evolving environmental standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products including surfactants, flame retardants, and silicone rubber. The company also earns income from investment returns, financial asset management, and provides customized chemical solutions and technical services to clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chenhua holds a leading position domestically in fine chemical new materials with advanced technology and strong customer relationships. It competes with other chemical manufacturers in China and internationally, leveraging its patented technologies, quality management, and expanding export capabilities to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 911 million, a slight decrease of 1.99% from the previous year, but net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 38.64% to about RMB 83.9 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.54 billion, showing steady growth. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chenhua emphasizes high-performance, customized fine chemical additives that enhance product processing and end-use quality. Its products are recognized for technological innovation, environmental friendliness, and compliance with international standards such as REACH. The company’s integrated R&D, production, and quality control systems enable it to offer differentiated solutions tailored to diverse industry needs, supporting sustainable development and green chemistry.
